ja342:1.1: Asakkhiṃ vata attānaṃ uṭṭhātum udakā thalaṃ, idān' āhaṃ puna tuyhaṃ vasaṃ gacchāmi vārija?.
ja342:2.1: Alam etehi ambehi jambūhi panasehi ca yāni pāraṃ samuddassa, varaṃ mayhaṃ udumbaro.
ja342:3.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ na khippam anubujjhati amittavasam anveti, pacchā ca-m-anutappati.
ja342:4.1: Yo ca uppatitaṃ atthaṃ khippam eva nibodhati muccate sattusambādhā, na ca pacchānutappatīti.
